$comment: Every file under schemas/conformance/reports/ (recursively) MUST have an entry here, and every entry MUST name a file that exists; scripts/validate-json.sh fails otherwise. expect: valid = passes aitp-conformance-report.schema.json and scripts/check-conformance-report.py; invalid_schema = fails the schema; invalid_check = passes the schema and fails the checker. Both negative kinds need a reason. Checked bidirectionally, like scripts/fixture-validation-map.json.

invalid/core-skip-under-passed-core-gate.reason: mh-success-001, a required core fixture, is skip (OP_NOT_SUPPORTED) while the "AITP v0.3" gate says passed; a core skip blocks the core claim.

invalid/missing-spec-commit.json.reason: spec.commit is absent; a report not tied to a spec commit cannot be reproduced.

invalid/totals-disagree-with-results.jso.reason: totals.core.pass is 85 but results hold 86 core passes; only the checker recomputes totals.
